description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git checkout functionalities, including branch switching, creating new branches, handling unmergeable changes, and other checkout behaviors.

methods.name: do_checkout
methods.description: Performs a git checkout operation with various options, handling expected success or failure, and verifying the checkout results.

methods.name: test_dirty_unmergeable
methods.description: Tests that a diff yields an exit code 1 when changes are unmergeable.

methods.name: test_dirty_unmergeable_discards_changes
methods.description: Checks that a dirty unmergeable change set is discarded upon checkout.

methods.name: setup_dirty_unmergeable
methods.description: Sets up the repository with unmergeable changes.

methods.name: test_dirty_mergeable
methods.description: Tests that a diff with cached changes yields exit code 1 when changes are mergeable.

methods.name: test_dirty_mergeable_discards_changes
methods.description: Checks that mergeable changes are discarded upon checkout.

methods.name: setup_dirty_mergeable
methods.description: Sets up the repository with mergeable dirty changes.
